visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed page-top banner: image with a centred white uppercase title, a muted looping background video, or an image on its own

contentPattern.structure: one cell (or several rows) holding: background image; title heading (h1 or h2); optional paragraphs and buttons. Video option: also a link to an .mp4 file (the image becomes the poster)
rows: image + heading + optional text/buttons (+ .mp4 link for video)

usage: Top of landing pages (image + title), home/careers (video), articles and press releases (image-only).
reuseGuidance: Use one hero per page as the first block. The video option needs an .mp4 URL link; the poster image is optional but recommended. Background video is muted, does not autoplay when the user prefers reduced motion, and always has a pause/play button.
